name: Powerplant
desc: Three Honeywell (Garrett) TFE 731-3-1C turbofan engines, 3,700 lbs takeoff thrust each at SL/ISA. ENG 1 and ENG 3 mounted in pods on the aft fuselage; ENG 2 in the tail with an S-duct inlet door. N1 is the thrust setting parameter. ITT is the temperature-limit parameter. Max N1 101.5% / N2 100% takeoff and max continuous.
keys: ITT limits: 907°C T/O normal, 885°C Max Continuous
Oil press: 38–46 PSI normal; 25 PSI min idle
ENG 2 has unique air inlet door — failure shows ENG 2 FAIL light
Engine Synchronizer prohibited for T/O, landing, missed approach

name: APU
desc: Auxiliary Power Unit installed in the aft fuselage. Used on ground for electrical and bleed-air loads. Ground operation only. With APU BLEED ON, engine and airframe anti-ice tests are prohibited. Provides 300 A of generator output.
keys: No anti-ice tests with APU BLEED ON
Bleed valve failed open: reduce engine power

name: Hydraulics
desc: Three independent hydraulic systems. System 1 (ENG 1) feeds primary flight controls and brakes; System 2 (ENG 3) is parallel for redundancy; System 3 (ENG 2) drives nose wheel steering, airbrakes, gear, flaps, slats. An electric STBY pump backs up System 1 (alt limit 45,000 ft). Fluid is MIL-H-5606. With either or both hyd systems inop, max speed 260 KIAS / 0.76 M.
keys: STBY pump backs up Sys 1 — 45,000 ft max
Loss of Sys 1: emergency slats, manual gear, #2 OFF for brakes
Loss of Sys 3 = no NWS, airbrakes, normal gear

name: Electrical
desc: 28 VDC DC system with three engine-driven generators (one per engine) and three Ni-Cd batteries. Four main DC buses: A, B, C, D. Bus Tie can be set FLIGHT NORMAL or TIED. Two static inverters provide 115 VAC for AC loads (max 750 VA each). Max DC bus voltage 32 V. Generator output 300 A up to 39,000 ft, 250 A above.
keys: 3 generators (one per engine) + APU gen on ground
Buses: A, B, C, D — BUS TIE switch

name: Fuel
desc: Three independent fuel systems (Left, Right, Center) totaling 15,514 lbs. Each engine has a dedicated feeder tank, boost pump, and transfer pump. Pressure refueling at the single point — max 50 PSI. Fuel computers must be operational for takeoff. No imbalance limit for flight.
keys: Fuel computers operational for T/O (except AFM Annex 5)

name: Pneumatics / Bleed Air
desc: Bleed air taps from each engine's LP and HP ports. The bleed system supplies the environmental control system (ECU — Cabin & Crew), pressurization, anti-ice, fuel tank pressurization, and S-duct anti-ice. CABIN, CREW, and PRV switches control flow. APU bleed available on the ground.
keys: LP & HP bleed from each engine
ECU Cabin and Crew air conditioning
BLEED OVHT light: PRV OFF, then sequence HP1/HP2/HP3

name: Environmental / Pressurization
desc: Two independent ECU packs — Crew and Cabin — provide conditioned air. Pressurization uses an outflow valve controlled by the cabin pressure controller. Maximum differential 9.1 psi (9.5 w/ SB163). Automatic and manual modes via the UP–DN control.
keys: Cabin alt > 10,000 ft → CABIN warning + horn
Smoke removal: descend below 12,000 ft, then DUMP + DV window

name: Flight Controls
desc: Conventional hydraulically-powered ailerons, elevators, and rudder. High-lift devices: leading-edge slats and trailing-edge flaps (positions: Slats only, Slats+20°, Slats+48°). Two-section airbrakes. Auto-slat extension at high AoA. Mach trim. Arthur Q feel system on elevator. Yaw damper required for cruise.
keys: Auto-slat: 270 KIAS max with light ON

name: Avionics
desc: Collins EFIS 86C14 with dual ADCs, dual FDS, APS-80 or APS-85 autopilot with autothrottle, dual VHF, dual VOR/LOC/GS, ADF, DME, transponders, weather radar, GPWS/EGPWS, TCAS. Yaw damper integrated with autopilot.
keys: APS 80/85 autopilot — OFF for T/O & landing
Min A/P approach: 50 ft (RA op) / 100 ft (RA inop)
Mach Trim inop + A/P off → max 0.78 M

name: Anti-Ice & Rain
desc: Engine inlet anti-ice (bleed-air heated lip), airframe (wing, slat, S-duct) anti-ice, windshield electric heat, pitot heat. Icing conditions: OAT < 10°C with visible moisture on ground, TAT 10°C in-flight. Engine/Wing anti-ice prohibited with OAT > 10°C.
keys: Wing A/I ground: testing only, short duration
Min N1 for anti-ice — see E-74

name: Landing Gear & Brakes
desc: Tricycle gear, hydraulically actuated. Nose wheel steering powered by Hyd Sys 3. Anti-skid system (must be operative for dispatch). Emergency gear extension by gravity (Hyd Sys 1 powers normal). Brake kinetic energy limits: 14,697 KJ normal RTO, 18,249 KJ max RTO.

name: Thrust Reverser
desc: ENG 2 only. Ground use only. Max N1 in reverse: 93%. Recommend 30 seconds continuous max and 4.5 minutes between consecutive uses. Reverser deployed in-flight: 230 KIAS limit. Go-around prohibited after thrust reverse selected.
